about: Format of the retrieval test cases. Copy to cases.json (git-ignored, because it names your papers and pages) and replace these made-up examples with questions about your own literature. A case passes at k if any of the top-k passages comes from an expected file and overlaps its page range. Phrase questions the way you would ask them, not with the words of the page. status: 'draft' until you have checked the expected pages, then 'approved'.

cases.question: How can a coherent rotation of sensors that grows along the beam axis be constrained in a track-based alignment?
Which track model includes multiple scattering and still gives the full covariance matrix for a global alignment fit?
